notes.title: RageBall Is Coming Soon
notes.notes:
RageBall will soon be available.
The day is fast approaching! RageBall is will be on steam. It's been a wonderful journey and a lot of support from the whole gaming community. We hope you all enjoy the game as much as we've enjoyed working on it.

FAQ

Will there be a mac/linux version?
Yes, we're currently working on getting those in next. We'll release another update when we have more information available.

Will there be online multiplayer?
Yes, we're currently working on getting those up next. Again there will be another release and we will give out more information on this when it is available.

I found a bug! What do I do?
Please forward all bugs to angelusdelacroix@hebistudios.com and we'll try and repair them as soon as we can! Also include your output log, which can be located in your RageBall Data folder. <Steam Games Directory>\steamapps\common\RageBall\RageBall 3.1_Data\output_log.txt
